title: Clients Pillar AI security hotfix 2.4.1
brief: Prepare an emergency production release for the Clients Pillar AI Incubator and Client Portal. A synthetic security review found a cross-tenant cache-key collision in the AI summary endpoint. The hotfix adds tenant isolation to cache keys, invalidates existing summary caches, and updates the client portal to handle refreshed summaries. No database schema or permission changes are included. Alex Morgan requested the release; Data Platform owns the cache fix, Taylor Reed manages the release, and Sarah Chen is the deputy. Luxembourg-regulated client services are affected. Plan a 10-minute customer-visible outage inside a one-hour evening implementation window. Treat change impact and deployment risk as high because both client-facing applications run in production. A security review and advance customer communication are required. This is entirely fictional demonstration data, not a real incident or test result.
